plugins.name: jbit
plugins.description: Just build it. Plans it. Proves it. Sees it through. JBIT (jay-bit, for Just Build It) turns a goal into one plan file of stages with acceptance checks; builds each stage, verifies it against the running product with evidence kept in the repo, has fresh eyes review it and commits it. Your own command, /jbit:autopilot or a message opening with "JBIT" such as "JBIT, just build it. Autopilot, lean.", sees the plan through unattended, logging the calls it makes for you; say attended to keep the stops for risky stages and your decisions, and outward to let push, publish and deploy through. Plain words without the name never set the level: they run at the one that stands, attended unless your own command set one for this plan. Also a roadmap of milestones for projects too big for one plan, a quick-fix path for small low-risk changes, a choice of how widely work fans out to agents, and a secret guard on commits.
